rows.title: One system, five cabinets
rows.text: VGt, VGs, VGx, VGd and VGo share voicing, rigging and networking, so a show scales without re-tuning.

rows.title: Power on board
rows.text: Each cabinet carries its own amplification and DSP. Fewer racks, shorter set-up, less to go wrong.

rows.title: Designed in Blueprint AV
rows.text: Model the room, place the arrays and hand the file straight to ArrayIntelligence on show day.
